title: US-Soviet Relations in the Cold War Era
description: Examines the origins and motivations of the US-Soviet conflict, the major events and crises of the Cold War and the social, political and cultural impacts of the struggle on both the superpowers and the broader world in the latter half of the 20th century.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 310B, HIST 318 (if taken in the same topic).
